_note: Curated facts used by narration. Each entry has a source and the date it was checked; review before relying on it.

SG.visa: Filipino passport holders can visit visa-free for up to 30 days.
SG.rules: Bring a passport valid for at least six months, proof of onward travel, and the free SG Arrival Card, filled in online within three days before you arrive.
SG.source: ICA Singapore (arrival card 3 days, free, 6-month validity, onward travel); 30-day visa-free from evisas.io, verified Feb 2026 - re-check ica.gov.sg

BH.visa: Filipino passport holders need an eVisa approved online before traveling.
BH.rules: Apply on the official Bahrain eVisa portal, and bring a passport valid for at least six months and a confirmed return or onward ticket.
BH.source: EntryBrief (reviewed Aug 2 2026) citing evisa.gov.bh; other sites conflict on fee/stay - re-check evisa.gov.bh
ofw: Working in Bahrain? A licensed Bahraini employer must sponsor your work visa with a confirmed job offer
OFW documents: passport valid for at least six months, signed contract, police clearance and a medical fitness certificate
OFWs also need an Overseas Employment Certificate (OEC) from DMW before flying, and should use a licensed agency
BH.ofw_source: terratern.com Bahrain employment visa guide (employer-sponsored via LMRA); OEC per DMW/DFA advisories - re-check dmw.gov.ph and lmra.gov.bh
